verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a RESTful Granola API with scoped API keys and an official MCP server, but nothing mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. A raw REST API is a developer building block, not an SDK, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so the docs offer nothing to generate a client from. The axis applies to a SaaS product like this one, so the absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
